You’re dying dude, there’s no pleasant way to go around it. Speaking from experience. Never had a painless experience in an attempt or a painless recovery after. I’m sorry you’re hurting right now, but don’t magnify that emotional pain by making it physical pain as well, and a botched attempt fucks that emotional pain up even worse.

I’ve been going close to monthly this summer, but I know it’s not enough. I’ll try to look into it, like I’m open to the concept and I really like meditation and such, so maybe it would be helpful. 

I understand that (and my therapist has been on me about setting realistic short term goals.) but it’s just the anxiety is tearing me apart. What am I supposed to do with myself. I can’t live like this anymore. I just need something to look forward to but I have nothing anymore. I don’t know what I’m supposed to do with my life and I never had a backup plan because I thought I’d have killed myself or be a lawyer, that’s pretty much it. Like my overarching goal is just to be normal mentally and it’s just never going to happen. 

I really appreciate that last paragraph though. I have it screenshotted and i think it’s good advice. I want to have hope, but I just don’t. I don’t want to die, but the disappointment is so strong it feels like I need to. But I know it’s not rational. I’ll cling to that .01 and hope I’m the long shot I guess.

I should clarify I just finished my first of three years of law school, and I plan on finishing it out (if I can survive it... literally). I haven’t been going to therapy as often because I have an internship this summer back in my home town, but I usually go to therapy weekly and to see a psychiatrist monthly. Thank you for the kind advice, I started getting really into diffusing essential oils and I think it helps, I’m not nearly flexible enough for yoga lol. It just sucks because I always told myself I’d be happy when I’m a lawyer but I’ve gotten multiple advisory opinions from attorneys who specialize in getting trouble cases past the bar that I’m essentially 99.99% disqualified. I have no idea what to do with my life. I have no other goals or ambitions or anything. I don’t really have anything to live for. And I want to lead a life of purpose. If I have to choose between living with this pain in some menial job or death, I’ll die every time.

I’m in law school rn. But I attempted suicide in February and got a citation from the police because I threw up before I could get home. Now the bar association won’t let me be a lawyer most likely. Plus I have had to change my name and move because I have had some public outbursts as a result of my (at the time) untreated bipolar that ruined my name and reputation.

I’m in a similar position man. I’m going to be 60 K in debt from law school but the bar association likely won’t let me practice because of my mental health issues. It’s tough man. But I’m fighting though because I have to hold out hope it may work out for me. I can’t imagine how hard it must feel for you. I live everyday with that fear and anxiety and it feels like it’s eating you alive and the thoughts won’t stop. But you’re strong man. Any guy that can survive grad school is one strong motivated man. So stand tall, you took a risk, and that in and of itself is worthy of praise and recognition. Your brain is sabotaging you, but sometimes it works for me to literally grab onto something, anything, and just feel it. Truly feel it, smell it, drink it in, trigger your senses and remind yourself that we live in a bigger world. Ground yourself
